title: Puharich hypnotizes Geller in Israel and the Nine come through

tellings.quote: has this whole episode in Israel before he even brings him back to the United States where he basically hypnotizes Geller and you know, the nine come through.

related.note: Hypnosis tapes in which Puharich himself suggests the Nine. This tells the Nine coming through under hypnosis as Puharich's leading questions rather than real contact, which is a different core claim about the same kind of session.

plain: Around 1970 or 1971 in Israel, a researcher named Andrija Puharich hypnotised a young man named Uri Geller, and a group of beings calling themselves "the Nine" began speaking through him. This all happened before Puharich brought Geller to the United States. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells it from Puharich's own book about Geller and from Puharich's tape recordings, and he also mentions a Dr. Vinod. The story matters because it is said to be the start of a scientist's contact with what he took to be an alien council.
